config.defaultLanguage: Default language for solving the problems.
config.showDescription: Specify where to show the description.
config.setDefaultLanguage: Show a hint to set the default language.
config.configWebviewMarkdown: Show a hint to change webview appearance through markdown config.
config.commentDescription: Show a hint to enable comment description in solution code file.
config.commandShortcut: Show a hint to configure commands key binding.
config.workspaceFolder: The path of the workspace folder to store the problem files.
config.filePath: The output folder and filename to save the problem files.
config.enableStatusBar: Show the LeetCode status bar or not.
config.enableSideMode: Open the top voted solution in the second editor column, beside the code.
config.enableSideMode.deprecated: No longer used: solutions open in Problem Details in the LeetCode sidebar, and results in the LeetCode Results panel.
config.followActiveEditor: Show the description of the active problem file in the LeetCode sidebar.
config.colorizeProblems: Add difficulty badge and colorize problems files in explorer tree.
